document.abstract: I wanted to start by speaking in French because we are in Montreal, and because I owe a debt to the program, as it is printed in French. Bi-lingualism fascinates me, and so I read the French as well as the English versions of my talk as it's given in this short form brochure that not all of you have. And I was struck by the difference, because in the English version, they speak of video cassettes as new medium; and in the French version it says video cassettes, 5 new medium.

authors.bio: Dr. Daniel I. Cooper has been the Director of Continuing Professional Development for McGraw-Hill Publications (330 W. 42nd St., New York, NY 10036) since 1969. Prior to that he was on the editorial staff for Nucleonics Magazine (McGraw-Hill), Executive Editor and later publisher of Science and Technology, and also a member of the technical staff of Bell Labs. Dr. Cooper received his B.S. Degree and Ph.D. in Nuclear Physics from M.I.T.
